args.title: Fix CSV header parsing with quoted fields
args.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

The parsing function should handle quoted fields for headers as it does for data lines. Modify the header parsing to use the splitFields function for consistent handling of quotes.

This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The CSV parser does not handle quoted header fields correctly, leading to a mismatch error. The code needs to apply the `splitFields` logic to the header line to allow quoted fields.
